name: Warm spell
story: A warm southerly flow brings the first truly warm day of the year: shirtsleeves on the apron, a soft haze over the far hills, cumulus building over the ridges late in the day.
forecast: Warm, 21 C in the afternoon. Haze, visibility 25 km. Cumulus over the hills from 13:00, base 1700 m. Light southwest wind. Mild night.
